title: Predecessor reports are invisible across run ids
description:
Found by tick nvn (run epic-9pd, attempt 12), which built the feature and then reported its own boundary.

nvn's discovery walks <ExecStateRoot>/<runID>/<tick>/<n>, so a re-dispatched attempt sees only attempts of its OWN run. Re-running an epic under a new run id re-dispatches the same ticks, and those attempts get none of the previous run's archived reports — the starting-blind case the tick exists for, one level up.

Close it with a discoverer keyed by tick (and epic) rather than by run id, or a run-start copy-forward of each tick's predecessor list. Prefer whichever keeps the reports local to the executor's state root, since worker prose must not move into the target repository.

Low: within one run id — the normal case, including every resume — the feature works.
acceptance_criteria: An attempt dispatched for a tick under a NEW run id is shown the archived reports of that tick's attempts from previous runs; a test re-runs an epic under a second run id and asserts the first run's report is offered
